rationale: Kept feedforward+PI structure but retuned for ~+45s delay and ~1.8x tau: lowered Kp to 0.55 and Ki to 0.014 with tight anti-windup (+/-0.15), replaced raw D with lead-compensated P on predicted y (Tp=35s, y_pred=yf+Tp*df, p=Kp*(target-y_pred)) to brake early despite delay, kept Tf=8s/Td=12s filtering and 0.80/0.70/0.80 safety caps, and made feedforward slowly adapt to u when |e|<0.04 and |df|<0.001 with bumpless transfer. This damps delay-induced overshoot/limit-cycle while still heating aggressively when far and re-learning u_ss if gain drifts.

extra.machine_card: Heater y in [0,1], u in [0,1]. Nominal: y_ss=ambient+K*u, ambient~0.20 (hidden cold-start ~0.05), K~0.93, tau~150s, dead-time~25s, u_ss(0.5)~0.32. Changed: K and ambient/loss similar (decay 0.0009 vs 0.0012/s), dead-time~70s, tau~280s. Requires lead compensation and lower PI gains; ff 0.05-0.75, Umax 0.80, soft cap 0.20 above 0.70, cutoff at 0.80/0.90.
extra.predicted_behavior: Cold start 0.05->0.5: u~0.60-0.68 for ~100s, y_pred braking cuts u to ~0.35 by y~0.42, overshoot <0.56 nominal and <0.58 slowed (vs 0.63 before), settles to 0.50+/-0.025 by ~280s nominal / ~350s slowed, u settles 0.30-0.34 nominal or adapted value slowed, in-band fraction >0.75 after 300s, MAE <0.03, no overrides/violations, no limit cycle (slope <0.0005/s at 900s).
extra.diagnosis: Nominal from E1-E6: ambient ~0.20, gain ~0.93 (0.3->0.469, 0.34->0.526), tau 130-180s, dead-time 15-40s, u_ss(0.5)~0.32. Post-change hidden v2 episodes: early heating 0.05->0.18 in 60s at u~0.62 vs nominal 0.178 expected, later 0.013 rise in 60s for du=0.14 vs 0.04 expected (~3x small); cut of du~0.5 for 80s (t260-340) drops y only 0.046 vs 0.186 expected nominal (~4x small); low-u decay at y~0.57 with u~0.10 is 0.0009/s vs E2 zero-input 0.0012/s at y~0.53 (within 25%, so loss unchanged). Yet overshoot to 0.61-0.63 persists and v2 enters sustained ~250s period oscillation (0.40-0.63) while v1 on same cold start was smooth. Weaker gain alone would lower loop gain and be more stable, outflow increase would speed decay - neither seen. Pattern is classic longer lag/delay: sluggish response + preserved zero-input decay + increased overshoot/oscillation. Estimate new dead-time 65-80s (+40-50s) and tau 260-300s (~1.8-1.9x). Designed for delay 75s, tau 280s.
